Swirled Slag Glass Cullet Specimen
Cullet Art Glass Rough Chunk
Mid-Century Style, Vintage
This striking slag glass cullet chunk displays vibrant bands of white, blue, turquoise, yellow, and orange swirled throughout layered glass matrix. Originating as foundry cullet or marble works byproduct, this dense decorative glass specimen features intricate bullseye banding, agate-style marbling, and raw fractured edges prized by lapidary artisans and glass collectors.
Multi-colored slag glass cullet with natural conchoidal fractures and raw textured surfaces
Prominent swirls of opaque white, translucent blue, green, and vibrant accent colors
Suitable as a decorative specimen, paperweight, bookend, or lapidary rough material
Measures approximately 4.5" x 4.5" x 4" and weighs 2.5 lbs
Condition:
Very good raw vintage condition. Displays characteristic rough cullet features including natural conchoidal fracture planes, sharp cleavage points, and factory kiln inclusions. Glass surfaces remain vibrant and stable with light earthen residue in recessed crevices consistent with salvaged glass rough.
